This is about intentional design. Building smart, automated engines online so that you can be fully present for the moments that matter offline. With your family, your friends, and yourself. It's the entire philosophy behind FieldWork. We build online so we can live offline. If you're an expert or founder who wants to build a business that serves your life, instead of the other way around, I put together a guide that walks through the framework. Comment FIELDWORK below and I'll send it over to you.
script: Beat 1: Visually stunning opening shot of an offline adventure (diving, hiking).
Beat 2: Simple, bold text overlay appears with the hook.
Beat 3: A short montage of 2-3 more candid, beautiful moments from the same scene.
Beat 4: The music swells as the final, epic shot lingers on screen.
Beat 5: The video ends, driving the viewer to the caption for the story and CTA.
guidance: This is a visual-only reel. Use your best, most cinematic B-roll. No talking to camera.
The hook is a short, bold text overlay placed center screen. Make it easy to read.
Use a trending, atmospheric, or inspiring audio track to set the mood. The sound is crucial.
The video sells the dream, but the caption tells the story and makes the offer. The caption does the heavy lifting.
The call to action is a keyword comment. Make it clear in the last line of the caption: 'Comment FIELDWORK...'
